DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Rupture

The ultrasound findings of a disruption in the uterine wall continuity adjacent to a prior C-section scar, combined with fetal distress and vaginal bleeding, are classic for uterine rupture. This is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate delivery and surgical intervention, not gastroenteritis. Please call your obstetric surgeon immediately to proceed to the operating room.
